memory_candidates.content: Lean 4 enumerability trap: a structure field of function type over an infinite domain (e.g. `bx : Formula -> Bool`, `IntPresentation.val : Atom -> ...`) makes the whole structure non-enumerable, so no `List` of candidates can be complete. The escape, when the function is only ever READ at a finite index set S0 (here: the boxed members of a subformula closure), is to enumerate `fun x => decide (x in S)` over `S in S0.powerset` and to write that canonical form into the STATEMENT of the completeness theorem that produces the structure -- not to add a normalization lemma afterwards. The canonical S may be obtained noncomputably (`Finset.filter` with `Classical.dec`) and the resulting closure term still computes, because only membership in a concrete `Finset` is evaluated. Recurs verbatim across BiLasso/Assembly.lean and WitnessFamily/, i.e. at least twice in one codebase.
